caption: Your YouTube email library
setupIntro: Set up a local library for YouTube email notifications.
setupManualHelp: Add channels manually and check their public feeds. Configure email after setup.
setupCreateConfig: BBYEN will create the missing configuration files with manual tracking and no initial video backlog.
setupPreserveConfig: Your existing configuration will be kept. BBYEN will create only missing files.
setupFailed: Setup could not start. Check the service logs and try again.
setupOtherModes: YouTube account and cookie setup will be available in a later dashboard update.
connectionStale: The last cookie check failed or contained unconfirmed bell states. Tracking may be out of date.
connectionApi: YouTube API tracking is active. Switching from API tracking is not available yet.
cleanupPending: Cookie cleanup is pending. If the previous cookies.txt was changed, remove it from the service configuration directory to finish cleanup before connecting again.
environmentCookie: A cookie is also set in the service environment; remove it there separately if desired.
cookieHelp: Paste a YouTube cookie header or export, or select a Netscape or JSON cookie file. The cookie is saved only after you review and confirm the channels. If a saved cookie fails, BBYEN can use an updated cookies.txt in the service configuration directory after verifying the same profile. The browser export must still be refreshed separately.
cookieError: Could not verify the cookie or complete the change. Check the connection and review again.
manualHelp: The channels below will remain monitored. The stored cookie will be deleted.
manualFileDelete: The matching cookies.txt in the service configuration directory will also be deleted.
manualExternal: Files on your computer and environment variables are not deleted.
manualPending: Manual tracking is active; cookie cleanup is still pending.
testSent: Test email accepted by the mail server.
testUncertain: Delivery could not be confirmed. Check your inbox and email settings before trying again.
credentialsHelp: Enter only the credentials you want to change. Saved values are never shown.
environmentOwned: Set by the environment; change it in Portainer and restart.
emailSaveError: Could not save email settings. Check the fields and try again.
credentialsError: Could not save credentials. Check the fields and try again.
libraryNote: Your collection grows as BBYEN checks for new uploads.
confirmationSaveError: Could not confirm the preference was saved. No unsubscribe was requested.
generalHelp: Channel-specific first-scan choices take precedence over this default.
apiPolicyHelp: Manage list membership on Channels or import lists in Subscriptions. Changing the policy requests a channel refresh and does not change YouTube subscriptions or bells.
videoViewDaysHelp: Applies when opening the dashboard; includes today. Enter 1 to 3650 days.
retentionHelp: Leave blank to keep details indefinitely. Older details are deleted on a video check; processed IDs remain to prevent duplicate emails.
activityRetentionHelp: Leave blank to keep activity indefinitely. Active incidents, pending deliveries, and unresolved YouTube actions are retained until resolved.
failureReminders: Remind me every 24 hours while an issue remains unresolved
recoveryEmails: Send an email when an issue recovers
reminderFailed: Reminder email delivery failed; check email settings.
recoveryFailed: Recovery email delivery failed; check email settings.
generalError: Could not confirm the settings. Check the values and reload before retrying.
importNeedsConsent: Confirm that invalid entries should be skipped before applying.
testHelp: Send a test using your saved email settings and credentials.
scheduleHelp: Use a number and unit, such as 6 hours or 3 days. The maximum is about 24 days. Changes apply without restarting.
scheduleError: Could not confirm the schedule. Check the intervals and reload before retrying.
exportHelp: Export channel lists and preferences without credentials or video history.
importHelp: Review additions, conflicts, and invalid entries before applying. No YouTube subscriptions or bells will be changed.
acceptPartial: Import valid entries and skip the invalid entries shown above
importCreates: The import creates these previously absent lists; an empty allowlist can change email selection:
importSummaryError: Could not preview that file. Check the JSON and try again.
importApplyError: Could not apply the import. Preview it again and check the channel configuration.
importSuccess: Import saved. Channel refresh has been requested.
importChooseFile: Choose a JSON file no larger than 2 MB.
addHelp: Find a channel from its handle, YouTube URL, feed URL or channel ID.
invalidCount: Enter a positive whole number of videos.
emptyVideos: No videos found for this range.
emptyChannels: No channels found. Add a channel to begin.
loadError: Could not load data. Check the service and try again.
resolveError: Could not find that channel. Check the address and try again.
help_smtp: Check your email configuration and credentials.
help_cookie: Check or replace the saved YouTube cookies.
help_auth: Reconnect the YouTube account and check its credentials.
help_quota: BBYEN will retry automatically after a delay.
help_other: Check the service logs, then try the refresh again.
addError: Could not save the channel. Try again.
added: Channel saved. Channel details will appear after refresh.
apiAddHelp: Add this channel to BBYEN tracking and the allowlist. This does not subscribe on YouTube.
cookieAddHelp: This subscribes on YouTube. Set the bell to All where available to start BBYEN monitoring; existing videos follow the default first-scan setting.
subscribeConfirm: Subscribe to this channel on YouTube? Set its bell to All where available to start BBYEN monitoring.
subscriptionSaved: YouTube subscription confirmed. Set the bell to All where available to start monitoring.
subscriptionPartial: The subscription was confirmed, but the All bell could not be confirmed. Review the channel before retrying.
subscriptionUncertain: The subscription change could not be confirmed. Review the request before another attempt.
subscriptionError: Could not verify the YouTube subscription. The request may have taken effect; check YouTube before retrying.
unsubscribeConfirm: Unsubscribe from this channel on YouTube? BBYEN will keep its history and settings.
undoIncomplete: Undo did not finish. Check the subscription and bell on YouTube; a request may still take effect.
undoAcknowledgeConfirm: Acknowledge the current state? An earlier YouTube request may still take effect.
undoReviewError: Review any uncertain subscription or bell request first, then try again.
undoPartial: The subscription may be restored, but the previous bell could not be confirmed. Check the channel before trying again.
undoError: Could not undo this unsubscribe. Check YouTube before retrying.
subscriptionReviewConfirm: The earlier request may still take effect. Acknowledge the current state and allow another change?
bellUnavailable: YouTube does not offer this bell option for the channel.
refreshRequested: Refresh requested. The list will update when it finishes.
invalidDates: Choose a valid date range that does not include a future day.
removeApiConfirm: Remove local manual tracking? YouTube subscriptions and email lists will stay unchanged.
removeConfirm: Remove this channel from manual tracking? Its video history and preferences will be kept.
removed: Channel removed. The channel list will update after refresh.
settingError: Could not save the notification setting.
bellError: YouTube did not offer this bell option or the change could not be verified. Check YouTube before retrying.
bellUncertain: The bell change could not be confirmed. Review the previous request before making another change.
bellReviewConfirm: The earlier request may still take effect. Acknowledge the current state and allow another change?
